claims.statement: The server leaves viewer, OAuth login/callback, and logout routes public and applies session authentication middleware to its other /api routes.

OAuth login stores a random state and a constrained frontend-relative redirect in a securecookie state cookie; the callback verifies the returned state before exchanging the code and resolving the GitHub user.
Successful GitHub account resolution sets a signed/encrypted session cookie for 30 days and redirects to the configured frontend URL; logout expires that cookie.
Unauthenticated viewer requests return an empty subscription map, while authenticated viewer responses include the resolved user and feed subscriptions.
A valid session identifies a user, but subscription handlers separately enforce path-user or subscription ownership; shared feed entries can be read by any authenticated user.
